publishedEvents.rule: The population views need one list of the notable changes across the whole catalogue; a per-object view needs that object's changes and fetches them with the object's history shard, which it is already fetching. So this list is the largest change on every object that had one, plus the largest remaining changes and every change an operator independently published, up to 1500. Nothing is hidden: every event is in its object's shard.
